notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.

Breadboard coordinates follow the catalogue convention: bank 't' = rows a-e, bank 'b' = rows f-j. In the image the a-e half is drawn at the bottom, so rail 'tn' is the black/negative rail and 'tp' the red/positive rail next to it.
Rail hole numbers (tp.1, tp.3, tn.1, tn.7) are estimated from the image and only approximate. What matters is that the rails are the 5V and GND rails.

The pushbutton straddles the centre gap in columns 4 and 6. Side 1 (column 4) is on the 5V rail via the orange wire; side 2 (column 6) goes to Arduino pin 2 via the teal wire and to the 10k pull-down resistor.
The 10k resistor runs from column 6 (row c) to column 9 (row c). A short black wire takes column 9 (row b) to the GND rail.
Matches the schematic: 5V -> switch -> node on pin 2, and that node -> 10k resistor -> GND.
The Arduino GND wire goes to the second GND pin on the power header, mapped to GND.2.
